# stb_image_resize

`stb_image_resize.h` v0.97 (public domain or MIT, see the file's end), from
<https://github.com/nothings/stb> at commit `003501f6d7a8668ce8b6d875e34dd97ad0d5d5b5`
(`deprecated/stb_image_resize.h`), unchanged: the resizer Unity 6000.0's
importer scales textures with.

# stb_image

`stb_image.h` v2.30 (public domain or MIT, see the file's end), from
<https://github.com/nothings/stb> at commit `003501f6d7a8668ce8b6d875e34dd97ad0d5d5b5`, unchanged: the decoder of
JPEG, Photoshop's composite image, TGA, BMP and GIF sources
(`stb_image.c` builds it without its file and HDR functions).
